summary: Several comments overpromise identity/allocation behavior, and three unresolved `NEEDS-HUMAN` notes remain in public iterator documentation.

items.issue: The comment says default immutable map implementations are returned unchanged. `Map.from` first checks `it.isEmpty` and returns `Map.empty`, so `HashMap.empty`, `ListMap.empty`, and `VectorMap.empty` are not returned unchanged.
items.suggestion: Qualify the identity claim with “when non-empty,” or document that every empty source returns the shared `Map.empty` instance.

items.issue: The comment guarantees a new map, but the implementation chains `removed`; built-in immutable maps return themselves when none of the supplied keys is present.
items.suggestion: Say it returns a map without the supplied keys, without promising a new instance.

items.issue: The comment promises a new map, but the body initializes `result` to `coll` and returns it unchanged when `that` is empty.
items.suggestion: Remove the guarantee that the result is new, or state that the receiver may be returned when no bindings are added.

items.issue: The comment says default immutable map implementations are returned unchanged, but the initial `isEmpty` case replaces every empty input with the shared `Map.empty` before the implementation-specific cases run.
items.suggestion: Document the empty-input case separately and limit the unchanged-instance claim to non-empty supported implementations.

items.issue: NEEDS-HUMAN: should this override retain its current nonstandard behavior for negative `n`? `i += n` rewinds the iterator and can replay elements, whereas the base `Iterator.drop` treats negative counts as zero.
items.suggestion: Resolve whether to change the implementation to clamp `n` at zero or explicitly document the intentional deviation; remove the NEEDS-HUMAN note before publishing.

items.suggestion: Add `@return this builder`, or rewrite the summary to begin “Returns this builder after adding …”.
